goal: Allow external applications using libbitcoinkernel to validate blocks without a full local UTXO database
Enable lightweight applications and custom indexers to run block validation on caller-provided coins
agreement: Multiple open and contested objections block progress
Unaddressed objection: caller-supplied lookup callback allows non-deterministic lookups (ajtowns)
Contested objection: script cache poisoning could lead to connecting an invalid block (w0xlt)
Contested objection: assertion crash on coins with invalid confirmation heights (w0xlt)
Support for the approach and validation without a full UTXO set (ismaelsadeeq, alexanderwiederin)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it adds block validation capabilities to libbitcoinkernel without a full UTXO set
Significantly expands library functionality for lightweight clients and external indexers

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it exposes a new entry point into consensus validation without mutating chainstate
Touches consensus checks and coin view handling that require careful validation review
